answer_2.quote: We assess generation diversity using a suite of established metrics, ensuring a comprehensive evaluation from both lexical and semantic perspectives... • Div-BLEU: Calculated as 1 -Self-BLEU . • EAD (Expectation-Adjusted Distinct Ngrams): Counts distinct 1-to 5-grams, adjusted to mitigate bias from shorter outputs . • Sent-BERT: Measures semantic diversity as 1average cosine similarity between Sentence-BERT embeddings of the responses ... Translation quality is assessed by the average of BLEU and COMET . Summarization quality uses the average of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L ... Generation quality is assessed using Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B-v0.2 as an automated reward model.
